b1_source: firmware/b1 of this repository, itself imported from the instrument at source_commit

firmware/b1/b1_app.c.note: DERIVED from B1's application: the cartographer/orchestrator replaced by the search orchestrator (b2_orch.c over b2_search.c), the `carto` record block by the `search` block, the identity's B2 fields, and the session's pair slice decoded from the identity page's flags in establish_identity — before the IDENT is built, because the IDENT declares it. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

firmware/b1/b1_wire.c.note: DERIVED from B1: app_identity 1.5.0 (the engine, the map digest, the fitness, the per-arm budget and this session's pair slice; B1's carto_version and probe_budget dropped) and loop_record 1.3.0 (the pre-rendered block is `search`, sorted between schema_version and seq). It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

firmware/b1/b1_wire.h.note: DERIVED from B1: the same two changes in the interface, plus the include guard.

firmware/b1/bsp/include/bspconfig.h.note: the BSP scaffold B1 hand-assembled for the Cortex-A9 standalone build (linker script and the three configuration headers), copied byte for byte; the B2 image links the same memory map and the same BSP configuration

firmware/b1/bsp/include/xmem_config.h.note: the BSP scaffold B1 hand-assembled for the Cortex-A9 standalone build (linker script and the three configuration headers), copied byte for byte; the B2 image links the same memory map and the same BSP configuration

firmware/b1/bsp/include/xparameters.h.note: the BSP scaffold B1 hand-assembled for the Cortex-A9 standalone build (linker script and the three configuration headers), copied byte for byte; the B2 image links the same memory map and the same BSP configuration

firmware/b1/bsp/lscript.ld.note: the BSP scaffold B1 hand-assembled for the Cortex-A9 standalone build (linker script and the three configuration headers), copied byte for byte; the B2 image links the same memory map and the same BSP configuration

note: byte-for-byte copies of the instrument's firmware at the archived head (kind=verbatim: the same bytes B1 imported, checked against B1's own import table), the BSP scaffold copied byte for byte from B1 (kind=verbatim, based on firmware/b1), plus three files DERIVED from B1 with their base hashes recorded: the wire unit and the application. b2_search.c/h, b2_orch.c/h, b2_twin.c and p3_data.h are B2's own and are derived from no instrument or B1 file. tests/test_b2_leakage.py verifies every verbatim file still hashes to its base and every derived file exists and differs from it.
